infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Veynlo uses Face ID to keep your inbox locked when you're not using the app.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Veynlo uses the camera to scan receipts and other documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Veynlo uses your photo library so you can attach an existing photo as a document.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Veynlo reads your device calendar so its events show up alongside everything else Veynlo tracks.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Veynlo reads your Reminders app so your tasks show up alongside everything else Veynlo tracks.
